text:
olivia: FYI console ingestion team rolled a header rename this morning: X-Route-Attr -> X-Rd-RouteMeta. Canary looked fine but dashboard mapping dropped ~10% of route metrics. Anyone seen SDK fallout?

jon: Saw errors from our TS integration tests, plus a handful of Go clients flagged missing route tags. The TS fetch wrapper asserts header names exactly and failed when only the new key was present.

anya: Py SDK tolerant because we lowercase and normalize headers at send-time. Node and Go don't. Repro: `curl -H 'X-Rd-RouteMeta: beta' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/complete` 1: server accepts but console shows empty route index for those hits.

mara: So the server accepts both keys but the console ingestion pipeline still keys on the old header name?

jon: Correct. Ingestion hasn't been updated to index the new name; they plan a backfill but that will take a bit.

sam: Short term we can deploy compatibility in SDKs: polyfill the legacy header when we detect X-Rd-RouteMeta present. Nonbreaking and reversible. We should gate it behind an env var RD_SDK_ROUTE_META_FORWARD=true so operators can opt-out.

olivia: Good. Can we push patch releases across SDKs today? Keep it minor/patch (no semver-major). Also add debug logs when shim is active.

anya: I'll slice PRs for Python and TypeScript. For Python small middleware: `if headers.get('X-Rd-RouteMeta'): headers['X-Route-Attr'] = headers['X-Rd-RouteMeta']` and unit tests.

jon: TS will transform in the fetch wrapper and add tests for header-casing on Windows. Go needs care with net/http canonicalization: example middleware: ```go
if v := req.Header.Get("X-Rd-RouteMeta"); v != "" {
    req.Header.Set("X-Route-Attr", v)
}
```
That should work but add cross-platform tests.

ci-bot: CI triggered: devex/sdk-compat-routemeta (#921) 1: windows runners failing header-casing assertion.

sam: I'll debug CI flakes, add explicit casing normalization and a test matrix: linux/mac/windows.

mara: Console/ingestion will run backfill and report per-route reconciliation. How long do we carry the shim? 30/60/90 days? Recommend 60 to give customers and pipelines time.

olivia: 60 days sounds reasonable. Publish a migration FAQ and a dashboard query to help teams find impacted routes (saved query: `routes where count(new_header) < expected * 0.9`). Add changelog note for patch with env var and logs.

anya: :thumbsup: PRs ready to open. We'll label them "telemetry compat: route meta polyfill" and target patch release channels.

jon: Once PRs green I'll coordinate TS + Go publishing and ping eng-release. Also add a short note for Dedicated/Private customers about private control planes that may need to update their ingestion pipelines.

sam: Will add RD_SDK_ROUTE_META_FORWARD=true (default true) and a RD_SDK_ROUTE_META_FORWARD=disabled opt-out in docs. Also add a debug line `polyfilled X-Route-Attr from X-Rd-RouteMeta` at debug level.

mara: I'll create the dashboard tile listing routes with >10% drop and a runbook for verifying backfill success.

olivia: Thanks team. Keep updates here with PR links and release times. Quick checklist: 1) PRs for py/ts/go 2) CI matrix fixes 3) env var + changelog 4) dashboard tile + backfill report 5) 60-day deprecation plan + public note.

ci-bot: test results: unit passed, integration flaky on windows - windows header casing fix pushed.

anya: PRs opened: devex/python#2384, devex/ts#4499. Linking in thread.

jon: Go PR in flight. Planning releases tonight (patch channel). Will post release notes and tags here when published.

olivia: Perfect. Thanks for moving fast on this.
